newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nihon Cement,Akebono plan car parts venture--paper.
newsitem.headline: Nihon Cement,Akebono plan car parts venture--paper.

text.p: Nihon Cement Co Ltd will set up a venture with Akebono Brake Industry Co Ltd to produce car parts, a Japanese daily said on Tuesday.
The new venture, to be called AKN, will be set up in Tokyo in mid-November, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.

The venture will be capitalised at 490 million yen, with Nihon Cement and Akebono Brake each holding a 45 percent stake in the venture and trading house Kanematsu Corp taking the remaining 10 percent, the paper said.
The venture will build factories in Japan and Southeast Asia, and expects to post annual sales of five billion yen in five years' time, the paper said.
The company will initially make lightweight parts for brakes using ceramic reinforced aluminium composite, the paper said.
Officials at Nihon Cement and Akebono Brake were not immediately available for comment.
